paper_level_summary_zh: 该论文在RFID声学窃听小节中描述了Tag-Bug系统，作为RFID声学窃听的代表性工作，但整个引用为普通的背景介绍，未强调亚毫米精度或首次性。

evidences.evidence_quote: [57] demonstrates the possibility of using low-cost and easily overlooked RFID tags to effectively perform through-the-wall eavesdropping.
